pair_direction: a_vs_b: 1 - mse_b/mse_a; positive favors recurrent/correct old state

regions.later: mean of remaining three target latent slices

statistics: Four-noise mean -> window -> video -> source group -> class macro. Within-class paired source-group bootstrap: 5000 draws, seed 2026. Three-training-seed mean and sample SD are descriptive; C is primary, B secondary.
donor_protocol: Fixed seed 2026; id-sorted metadata-only selection within split/class, different video and source group; identical mapping for all training seeds. Ineligible windows have index -1, empty donor id, donor_valid=false; their shuffled NPZ values are self-state placeholders excluded from analysis.

cohorts.arm_rule: shuffled_C MSE/by_t and shuffled comparison use eligible rows; all other arm MSE/by_t and comparisons use full rows
